lines.text: Short golfers can still hit it far.
A short arc costs you distance.
As the club goes back, your arms fold.
At the top, the club sits tight to your head.
So you swing harder to make up for it.
A small circle gives the clubhead less runway.
Swinging harder won't make the circle bigger.
Rory McIlroy is listed at five foot ten.
In 2023, he led the PGA Tour in driving distance.
Watch his arms. They stay long going back.
Wide on the way back. Wide on the way through.
Width is a feel you can train, the app I'm building opens each drill with a checkpoint like this, so here's yours.
Start the club low and wide away from the ball.
Keep your lead arm long, not locked.
Then let your arms extend after the ball.
